Second step of `swe-ledger` (track 10). Extracts 517 commits / 396 projects from `oss-monorepo` history and compares with the run-log snapshot.

Findings (all from `experiments/results.txt`): all 157 projects created since 2026-10-13 are in the run log; the 217 it lacks are pre-log bulk output (09-29/09-30); 49% of projects sit in follow-up families; 6/234 fully observed projects (2.6%) have a correction-worded later commit (a lower bound, not a defect rate). No tokens/cost/CI data. Preliminary.

Checks: 9 tests pass; `python site/build.py` prints ok; README bullet and projects.json entry added; README numbers checked against results.txt. Citations: Forsgren et al. 2018, Wilson 1927 (both carried over from swe-ledger).
